A '''Cathorn''' was a creature [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-constructed]] from a feline animal of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Charon homeworld|Charon]]. It exhibited [[Armor/Legends|armor]]-like hide, and had the spiked tail of an [[Ithorian Barbed Flyer]] grafted to its body. It was capable of leaping long distances.

A Cathorn was aboard the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Desolate]]'', and it [[Skirmish on the Desolate|attacked]] a group of exploring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] in the ship's [[altar of death]].
